head: codex/191-secure-durable-openraft
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16a] Secure and durably persist three-voter OpenRaft transport
body:
Closes #191

## Summary
- add a real three-voter OpenRaft substrate over mutually authenticated QUIC with signed polis sessions and authority-derived topology
- persist vote, log, state-machine, snapshot, boot-generation, and exact-retry response state with crash reconciliation and an external rollback checkpoint
- enforce bounded canonical framing, replay conflict rejection, certificate/boot rotation, idle deadlines, path safety, and deterministic snapshot identity
- provide the secure consensus substrate required by the later Guardian/kernel/Observatory operational integration children; this PR does not claim the full #142 live Wuji/AWS demonstration

## Validation
- focused serial nextest target: 14/14 passed
- strict focused Clippy with `-D warnings`: passed
- canonical issue receipt validator: passed
- exact 14 machine-derived cases: passed
- full base-to-head diff hygiene: passed

## Review
Independent findings-first review approved final clean evidence head `f7311b24c76a1d83cf18e05df55f368bd92ecb04` with no P0-P3 findings after two remediation rounds. Hosted CI and the operator's external PR review remain required. This PR must not be merged before that external review is complete.
